title: Password change does not terminate the user's other sessions
vulnerable_behaviour: POST /password updates the credential and responds 200 but leaves every other IdP session of the user, and the tokens bound to them, alive.
fixed_behaviour: POST /password terminates every other IdP session of the user (revoking their tokens and delivering back-channel logout), keeping only the session that performed the change.

artifact.holder: RP1 (on behalf of a second browser of the same user)
artifact.issued_by: IdP /token (authorization_code) under the user's second IdP session

termination_trigger: explicit credential change: POST IdP /password from browser A (200, changed=true)
declared_expected_scope: every session of the user other than the one performing the change
all tokens bound to those sessions
protected_operation: GET RS /api/data with the access token obtained by browser B before the password change
standards: OWASP ASVS 5.0 V7.4.3 (option to terminate other sessions; not a universal automatic-termination requirement)
Explicit synthetic policy: terminate other sessions and their tokens after password change
cwe_rule_path: adjacent withdrawal event present (credential change reported successful)
pre-event artifact from another session presented after the event
=> adjacent-authority-withdrawal failure under the declared laboratory policy (paper class B)
